reports.description: Mr. Bradley Weber called me and said with his company TF Global Markets, it`s easy to make money, and have a lot of opportunities. He said only required $250 so, I deposited that money. In order to deposit the money, Bradley told me to open an account at Coinberry. I put money through e-transfer from my bank RBC, bought BTC, and sent BTC to the company. Since I didn‚Äôt know how to do it Mr. Bradley helped me through team viewer. He told me he`ll manage my account and I don‚Äôt have to worry about anything since the risk is not involved, and I can withdraw my money whenever I need it. After two weeks my profit looked impressive and Bradley convinced me to put more money in the account. He called me every day and whenever we deposited more he was the one who helped me to make the transactions since I didn‚Äôt know how to do it. Once I could not log into my Coinberry account so he would help me and gave me my 2FA code. After a couple of days later I could not log in to my Coinberry account because I didn‚Äôt have the 2FA code. Then a couple of days later a lot of transactions were made without my permission and knowledge. I kept emailing Coinberry support since I couldn‚Äôt log in to my account, then they messaged me days later that my account balance is zero. I knew it can only be Mr. Bradley since nobody had access to my account just him. Then I tried to log into my tf global markets account but it didn‚Äôt let me in, said it doesn‚Äôt recognize my email. I tried to call them and email them but I got no answer since then.
